sentences.text: Det er mye mat hos Marta: fisk og poteter.
sentences.english: There is a lot of food at Marta's: fish and potatoes.

sentences.text: Det er søndag. Etter kirka er Sam, Anna og Lars hos Marta.
sentences.english: It is Sunday. After church Sam, Anna and Lars are at Marta's.

sentences.text: Nils er også hos bestemora.
sentences.english: Nils is also at his grandmother's.

sentences.text: Marta lager middag. Hun lager middag hver søndag.
sentences.english: Marta is making dinner. She makes dinner every Sunday.

sentences.text: Her er maten! Det er fisk og poteter. Det er også suppe.
sentences.english: Here is the food! There is fish and potatoes. There is also soup.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Det er mye! Jeg er sulten.
sentences.english: There is a lot! I am hungry.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg er sulten også. Men jeg er glad.
sentences.english: I am hungry too. But I am happy.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Vi spiser. Etter suppen spiser vi mer.
sentences.english: We eat. After the soup we eat more.

sentences.text: Er maten bra, Sam?
sentences.english: Is the food good, Sam?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, det er veldig bra!
sentences.english: Yes, it is very good!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg liker fisk. Jeg vil ha mer.
sentences.english: I like fish. I want more.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Her er mer.
sentences.english: Here is more.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Vil du ha mer potet, Sam?
sentences.english: Do you want more potato, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne.
sentences.english: Yes, please.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg lager middag hver søndag.
sentences.english: I make dinner every Sunday.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Du er hos meg på søndag, Sam.
sentences.english: You are at my place on Sunday, Sam.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne! Jeg liker deg, Marta.
sentences.english: Yes, gladly! I like you, Marta.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Og jeg liker deg, Sam!
sentences.english: And I like you, Sam!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Lars drikker kaffe. Nils drikker melk.
sentences.english: Lars drinks coffee. Nils drinks milk.

sentences.text: Jeg vil ikke ha mer kaffe. Jeg er trøtt.
sentences.english: I do not want more coffee. I am tired.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg er trøtt også. Jeg jobber mye på klinikken.
sentences.english: I am tired too. I work a lot at the clinic.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Du jobber mye, Anna. Du er trøtt i dag.
sentences.english: You work a lot, Anna. You are tired today.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, men jeg er glad.
sentences.english: Yes, but I am happy.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Etter kaffen går Lars og Anna.
sentences.english: After the coffee Lars and Anna leave.

sentences.text: Nils bor hjemme, men i dag er han hos Marta.
sentences.english: Nils lives at home, but today he is at Marta's.

sentences.text: Sam går også. Han er ikke trøtt. Han er glad.
sentences.english: Sam goes too. He is not tired. He is happy.

sentences.text: Ha det bra, Marta!
sentences.english: Goodbye, Marta!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ha det bra, Sam!
sentences.english: Goodbye, Sam!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Du er glad i dag, Marta.
sentences.english: You are happy today, Marta.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Takk, Anna! Du vil ha mer. Du er trøtt.
sentences.english: Thanks, Anna! You want more. You are tired.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, jeg vil gjerne ha mer.
sentences.english: Yes, I would like more.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Etter middagen er Sam i huset. Rommet er lite, men han er glad.
sentences.english: After dinner Sam is in the house. The room is small, but he is happy.

sentences.text: Kafeen er bra! Jeg vil ha brød med ost, og jeg vil ha melk.
sentences.english: The café is good! I want bread with cheese, and I want milk.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Jeg er ikke mett.
sentences.english: I am not full.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Mora og faren til Anna bor i Trondheim. Familien er stor.
sentences.english: Anna's mother and father live in Trondheim. The family is big.
